title: Best reminder App
body: The best feature is that you can set Critical Timers that will notify you even when your phone is in Do Not Disturb mode.

title: Simple and reliable
body: No nonsense, keeps reminding if you ignore and don’t dismiss the reminder, and just works without any major issues. Costs some money? Yes, but it’s well worth it. If you’re looking at this app because regular reminders and calendar doesn’t do what you need done, there’s probably a good reason you should just go for it.

author: Grynderi

title: Best reminder and alarm
body:
Omg I love this so much
The first time I wondered if this really is worth the money, but then when I use it I never regret it
I can make any reminder really quick and fast
Reuse it really fast also
It is made in a way that none of other apps can compare. So simple so fast
It reminds me until I choose complete the task (I never forget and miss a reminder ON TIME)
Dropbox sync is also an awesome feature as I can make reminder from my computer and it will automatically show here.
Finally, even if I turn off the app it still reminds me ^__^
I am so happy with it.
Prompty support on Twitter really fast.
I love it.
author: Santtu Mikko

title: Very fast, very easy, very good
body: Due makes it very easy to set reminders for everything that you need to get done that doesn't work in a calendar (almost everything, in my experience - big projects have small steps...) and doesn't leave you alone until you've done it. Very well thought-through, and keeps getting better. It also has super nice multiple timers (bonus shortcut: swipe left or right at the top header to switch between reminders and timers)!
author: Signs7

title: Nopeasti muistutuksiin
body:
Due:lla pienten muistutusten kirjaaminen on nopeaa, kun et halua niitä kalenteriisi ja isommat tehtävienhallintasovellukset (Things, OmniFocus) ovat liian työläitä. Käytännöllisen kaunis ja toimiva.

Due is very good in putting small remainders for yourself, that you don't want in your calendar and would be too much effort and in wrong context with bigger task managers like Things. Due is fast and easy.

title: Hyvä ja yksinkertainen!
body: Tulee käytettyä tätä päivittäisten ja usein toistuvien asioiden muistamiseen, siinä missä 2Do pitää kirjaa mm. projekteista yms. Tiedot voi syöttää nopeasti ja kuitata vielä nopeammin. title: Extremely useful app
